# authwise_secret (Data Source)

Reads a secret's metadata by its full resource name — for referencing a secret managed elsewhere. The material is never readable.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the secret to read.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `external` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external))
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `version` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--external"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `store` (String)
